g.text: Beam envelope check (ports swapped) – to scale · variant L4 = 250 mm / L5 = 100 mm
Assumes objective NA 0.55 (EFL 10 mm → beam Ø11 mm), exit pupil at the objective back end (blue bar), FoV 1×1 mm, thin lenses, geometric rays. Grid = 100 mm.
Clear-aperture check (field edge in-plane, ±0.5 mm; "max field" = largest field radius that passes the element without clipping)
Transmitted port → Basler (path incl. common part)
limiting: DM (±0.75 mm) – full FoV passes
Reflected port → qCMOS (path incl. common part)
limiting: DM (±0.75 mm) – full FoV passes
Allowed r = 0.9 × radius of the optic; ×0.707 for 45° mirrors/DM (in-plane). Green ≥ corner (0.71 mm) · orange ≥ edge (0.50 mm) · red < edge. Glyphs: ComponentLibrary, A. Franzen, CC BY-NC 3.0.
